correctness.rationale: A mixed sign string admits a strictly exposing objective: subtract the mean from its ±1 entries and integrate the resulting zero-sum edge differences. The incidence kernel is exactly the constants, so the mixed images are distinct; equality of the independently chosen vertices is allowed. The difference coordinates are cyclic increments of w=(s-t)/2. A closed-walk trace counts these increments with multiplicities 1,2,1; fixing one sign string constant gives the binary trace, and inclusion-exclusion restores four zero-distance pairs. The symmetric transfer block has trace 3+z^4 and determinant 2(1-z^2)^2; the antisymmetric eigenvalue is 1-z^4. For the unconditioned cyclic sum the summands have mean 1, variance 3/2 and adjacent covariance 1/4, including all three unordered pairs at n=3; the analogous binary transition indicators have mean 1/2 and zero pair covariance. Subtracting their moment sums gives the two exact moments. Cut the cycle by changing one bounded term and apply the bounded 1-dependent CLT of variance rate 2; excluding the two constant inputs from each string costs at most 2^(2-n) in total variation. The square-root identity gives the second CLT. Parity follows by telescoping mod 2. With any zero state the distance is <=4n-6; otherwise maximal opposite transitions give the two even-order alternations or the 2n odd-order patterns with one agreeing edge.
residual_risks: The bounded histogram replay does not check weak convergence; the asymptotic reasoning supplies that check.

value.rationale: Uniform-vertex chord lengths are a canonical metric statistic of this Euclidean realization. A fixed-order recurrence determines every ordered pair multiplicity, beyond orientation counts, one-point radii and moments; it allows exact probabilities for clustering or extreme distances without enumerating exponentially many pairs. The finite law and explicit unit-scale Euclidean fluctuations give useful complementary descriptions. The transfer technique and generic CLT are not themselves value claims.
residual_risks: No local limit theorem, quantitative error bound, or extension to other embeddings or sampling measures is established.
